title: Nevers to Pisany and to Revol, August-October 1593, BnF fr. 3985 and fr. 3986 (catalogue item 21)

steps.what: Gallica full-resolution canvases of fr. 3985, 3986, 3995 fetched; items mapped to folios.
Key no. 46 transcribed from fr. 3995 f. 87 at full resolution.
Alphabet checked on Gondi's 22 Sept letter with the office decipherment.
8 Sept letter to Pisany read whole.
14 Oct letter to Pisany read in long stretches; garbled stretches left.
Revol letters found to be in the Court key no. 60, not no. 46; the 27 Aug copy is in clear.
Key no. 60 transcribed in full from fr. 3995 ff. 109-111 and checked on the interlined King's letter of 7 Oct.
f. 146v and f. 157v transcribed and decoded; anchors only, copyist's cursive forms block the rest.
Instruction of 31 Aug found in print (Memoires de Nevers ii) and interlined in fr. 3985; glyph atlas begun.
Outside input, issue #32 (tunarob): 14 proposed key no. 60 corrections, a 4/2+ tag split, transcription of fr. 3985 f. 88r-v and a manual partial reading of f. 88r (LLM-assisted).

Each key correction checked on full-resolution fr. 3995 f. 109 and f. 111: 10 confirmed and adopted (b = o-, c flag, i hook+, o \\, m ɱ, u 2+, ‡/‡-loop, ♀ = u, ∩+ = g, o-o = c, o+o = y), 2 rejected (be, # in compounds); tags ſ+/4+/4+b/4/2+/n+ split.
f. 146v and f. 157v re-tagged and re-decoded with the corrected key; unresolved 29/204 and 68/226 tokens, no new reading.
f. 88r R5 'de absolution' (needs the corrected b), R6 oo+ le Roy and f++ qu'il, checked on the image; Tomokiyo's 'conversion' rejected (needs q = c).
f88/shuffle_control.py: longest lexicon word over 86 R3-R6 tokens = 10 letters (absolution); 0/5000 token permutations reach it, P = 0.0002.

outcome.method_basis: The Pisany letters were read with Tomokiyo's Nevers cipher no. 46, transcribed here at full resolution from BnF fr. 3995 f. 87 and checked on Gondi's 22 Sept 1593 letter with its office decipherment; the Revol letters are in Court key no. 60; one passage of f. 88r (21 Aug) is read in part with the key as corrected from issue #32, the rest are not read.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Not measurable as a token share: the Pisany letters are counted (decode_f209.txt 122/122, decode_f168.txt 268/269 figures resolve in key no. 46), but the Revol transcriptions ct_3986_f146v.txt and ct_3986_f157v.txt mix clear cursive with cipher and are not yet segmented, and four Revol passages (ff. 88, 115, 176, 198) are untranscribed, so the denominator is unknown; 0.3 is by letters (2 of 7). Unchanged after issue #32 (12 Oct 2026): f. 88r adds three words (de absolution, le Roy, qu'il), not a letter.
outcome.notes: Two of seven letters read (Pisany); five Revol letters in key no. 60 unread, blocker palaeographic. fraction_read 0.3 is an estimate by letters (2 of 7 read, the second in stretches); no token count exists for the Revol passages.

gaps.detail: microfilm copy, 1/7, 0/8, 3/5 confusable; segscore.py did not resolve them
